title: VaultOverride
description: A lightweight Paper plugin that gives administrators precise control over Trial and Ominous Vault rewards with one-time, player-targeted loot overrides.
body:
# 🏛️ VaultOverride

VaultOverride is a lightweight Paper plugin for Minecraft 1.21.x that gives server administrators complete control over Trial Vault and Ominous Vault rewards. Whether you're creating scripted SMP events, custom progression systems, or surprising players with hidden rewards, VaultOverride makes it simple to customize vault loot without editing loot tables or using complicated datapacks.

With a single command, you can replace one of the six reward slots in the next Trial or Ominous Vault opening. Overrides can be applied globally 🌍 or targeted to specific players 👤, making it perfect for custom events, secret rewards, and content creation.

Each override is one-time use 🔄. Once the player opens the vault and receives the reward, the override is automatically consumed, keeping gameplay balanced and making every event feel special.

VaultOverride also synchronizes the vault's displayed item ✨ with the custom reward, providing a seamless experience for players. Pending overrides are automatically saved 💾, ensuring they survive server restarts.

## ✨ Features

- 🏛️ Support for Trial Vaults and Ominous Vaults.
- 🎁 Replace specific reward slots (1–6).
- 🧩 Use any Minecraft item as a reward.
- 👤 Target individual players.
- 🌍 Apply overrides globally.
- 🔄 One-time reward overrides.
- 💾 Automatic saving and loading.
- ✨ Vault display item synchronization.
- ⚡ Lightweight and easy to use.
- ⌨️ Tab completion support.
- 🛠️ Built exclusively for Paper and Paper-based forks.

## 📜 Commands


```
/drop <trial|ominous> <1-6> <item> [player]
```

📌 Examples


```
/drop ominous 3 heavy_core Steve
/drop trial 1 mace
/drop ominous 5 diamond_block
/drop clear
```


## 🖥️ Compatibility

- ✅ Paper 1.21.x
- ✅ Purpur
- ✅ Pufferfish

- ❌ Spigot [not tested yet]
- ❌ Bukkit [not tested yet]

## 🎬 Perfect For

- 🎥 Content creators
- 🌟 Scripted SMPs
- 🎉 Special server events
- 🗝️ Custom progression systems
- 🎁 Hidden rewards and surprises
- 🏹 Adventure and challenge servers

VaultOverride provides a simple but powerful way to take control of Trial Chamber rewards and create memorable experiences for your players.
